processDescription: High-precision laser and waterjet cutting of laser micro-cutting tube for titanium components. Capable of producing complex geometries, internal cutouts, and edge preparations with ±0.05 mm laser tolerance and zero HAZ via waterjet process.
heatControl: For laser cutting of laser micro-cutting tube, high-purity nitrogen or argon coaxial assist gas shields the cut zone from atmospheric oxygen, preventing alpha-case formation and discoloration. Waterjet cutting eliminates thermal concerns entirely.
flatnessControl: Post-cutting stress relief (vacuum annealing) and precision leveling available for laser micro-cutting tube components requiring flatness within 0.5 mm/m.
capabilitiesDescription: Our facility combines multi-kilowatt fiber laser cutting systems with high-pressure abrasive waterjet systems, enabling us to process laser micro-cutting tube from prototype to production volumes.
